description: This file defines classes, macros, and functions related to warning reporting control within the Thunder project. It includes mechanisms for categorizing, serializing, and managing warning categories, as well as proxy classes for handling warning events and configurations.

classes.name: WarningReportingBoundsCategory
classes.description: Template class managing bounds and analysis for specific warning categories, including serialization, deserialization, and warning level determination.

classes.name: WarningReportingType
classes.description: Template class representing a warning reporting category, including analysis, serialization, and control functionalities.

classes.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy
classes.description: Singleton proxy class managing warning reporting units, including event reporting, category management, and configuration.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures warning bounds and specific settings for a category.

methods.name: CategoryName
methods.description: Returns the name of the warning category.

methods.name: Analyze
methods.description: Analyzes whether a warning should be reported based on current bounds and category logic.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the category data into a buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes category data from a buffer.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts category data to a string representation.

methods.name: IsWarning
methods.description: Determines if the current value is considered a warning.

methods.name: Enabled
methods.description: Checks if the warning category is enabled.

methods.name: Enabled (setter)
methods.description: Enables or disables the warning category.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Cleans up the warning category control.
